$help: How the site's emails are routed. The sender (an n8n workflow, mail/README.md) reads this file from GitHub on every request, so a saved change applies within a minute.
mode: "test" sends every internal notice to inbox.test and marks its subject; "live" sends to inbox.live. The kit email always goes to the person who asked for it.
sender: the From line. address must be the mailbox the n8n credential sends from. replyTo is where the kit reader's reply lands.

kit.allowedDomains must match sellerGate.allowedDomains in site/data/config.js (the checker compares them). kit.perAddressPerDay and limits.perHour cap sends, so the form cannot be used to flood anyone.
